items.summary: ComEdがHighland Parkで電柱更新の許可を取得(1件)
items.verbatim: ComEd proposes to replace two new utility poles east of the identified wetland in order to ensure reliable electrical service. Both pole replacements are within 30 feet of the wetland. Straw wattles will be installed around the pole replacements to limit sediment migration to the identified wetland.
